d: With Orhun away, Sophia took the initiative of orienting her new substitute teacher to the guild facilities. She intended to keep the tour brief but the instructor noticed Sophia's stress regarding the upcoming test and insisted on bringing her back to his personal quarters. With the test setting in, is Sophia making the most of her time, cramming every night with the substitute instructor late at night before Orhun comes back? or will it all be for nothing?
